changelog:
🐛 Bug Fixes
• Downloads: Allow using in-app downloads with player overlay external download button
• Export only filtered logs and stream file exports efficiently
• Temporarily revert patches-library update to fix app startup crash
• YouTube - Add to queue: Fix Premium-style queue bugs
• YouTube - Ambient mode: Force Ambient mode when the server turns it off
• YouTube - Captions: Restore all translation menu getter routes
• YouTube - Captions: Restore translations from original caption sources
• YouTube - Captions: Show auto-translated captions of styled caption tracks
• YouTube - Custom font: Show custom font picker if no font is selected yet
• YouTube - Default video quality: Forcely disabled automatic stock quality selection and deprecated the code to handle both Stock/Morphe quality selections
• YouTube - Default video quality: SABR video quality drops while the video plays
• YouTube - Default video quality: Video quality drops while the video plays
• YouTube - Disable translucent bar: Replace flag override with a proper patch
• YouTube - Downloads: Music videos may not download
• YouTube - Downloads: Playing video enters picture-in-picture when the external downloader opens
• YouTube - Feed card layout: Remove the feed vertical spacing override, which can crash the app
• YouTube - Feed card layout: Round the top outer corners of the Shorts shelves
• YouTube - Feed card layout: Shorts shelves of the search results are not cards
• YouTube - Feed card layout: Show missing watch progress on feed cards
• YouTube - Feed card layout: Sort buttons of the channel tabs have a card background
• YouTube - Feed card layout: Vertical video shelves are not cards
• YouTube - Feed cards layout: Cards sometimes lose spacing
• YouTube - Feed cards layout: Keep horizontal layout for search results on tablets
• YouTube - Feed cards layout: Make new style more consistent
• YouTube - Feed video actions: Show on the grid of landscape
• YouTube - Feed video actions: Watch later button opens the share sheet
• YouTube - Feed view count: Keep the badge away from the edges of inset thumbnails, show lakh and crore units
• YouTube - Feed view count: Show on the grid of landscape, same corners and text size as the other badges
• YouTube - Force animations: Animate page transitions when the server turns them off
• YouTube - Forced video codec: Excluded VP9 stream with forced AVC superseeded by Shorts VP9 with SABR restarting fix
• YouTube - Hide layout components: Video titles being hidden on 20.21.37
• YouTube - Hide preview comment: Removed the timestamp from the Spanned String instead of disabling its tap logic
• YouTube - Jam queue sharing: Keep the YouTube Music player aligned when Jam queue sharing is off
• YouTube - Minimal comments button: Hide page selector with new layout
• YouTube - Minimal miniplayer: Apply minimized position based on commit #9d8b0df43 insets
• YouTube - Minimal miniplayer: Bar is cut off by the display cutout in landscape
• YouTube - Minimal miniplayer: Show DeArrow title on type 1 style
• YouTube - Miniplayer: Match minimal miniplayer icons by content description name instead of resource id
• YouTube - Miniplayer: Watch transition animation is missing
• YouTube - Navigation bar: App crashes on Android 12-13 when the player is dragged down to the miniplayer
• YouTube - Navigation bar: bug: Navigation bar is not disabled in shorts player
• YouTube - Navigation bar: Increased the spacing between Shorts player and navigation bar when this latter is hidden
• YouTube - Navigation bar: Navigation bar grows and covers the page when the keyboard is open
• YouTube - Navigation bar: Navigation bar is raised and an empty bar is left at the bottom
• YouTube - Navigation bar: Navigation bar is raised and an empty bar is left at the bottom on Android 11 and lower
• YouTube - New feed cards layout: Rounded edges and padding was wrong
• YouTube - Open system share sheet: Build link from share entity
• YouTube - Reload video: Videos playing in the feed replace the reloaded video
• YouTube - Restore original titles: Do not reload the same video title once the player is opened
• YouTube - Return YouTube Dislike: Place the feed thumbnail like count on inset thumbnails and channel posts
• YouTube - Spoof video streams: In-app downloads are slow when using spoof streaming
• YouTube - Video quality: Fix VP9 Shorts restarting in a loop with spoofed SABR streams
• YouTube - Video quality: Improved Shorts VP9 SABR loop restarting fix
• YouTube - VideoInformation: Separated Video and Shorts informations
• YouTube - VideoInformation: Videos loaded in the background replace the video and playlist IDs of the player
• YouTube: "Play next/last in queue" does nothing from feeds when no video is playing
• YouTube: Add missing experimental compatibility declaration
• YouTube: App can crash when an observer removes itself while it is notified
• YouTube: Channel search not working properly
• YouTube: Comments button page indicator is invisible with the light theme
• YouTube: Error toasts on app startup with YouTube 21.40+
• YouTube: Fixed some 21.42+ fingerprints
• YouTube: Flyout menu text is cut when Morphe items are added
• YouTube: Force show translucent navigation bar
• YouTube: History items are hidden when the keyboard is open
• YouTube: Light/Dark theme colors are wrong
• YouTube: Restore Edge TTS and add voice catalog refresh
• YouTube: Some external links can not be opened
• YouTube: Status bar becomes dark
• YouTube: Status bar is opaque, black bar above the player and crash on startup
• YouTube: Video metadata panel text can not be read with the light theme
• YouTube: Watch page background turns black in light mode

✨ New Features
• Spoof video streams: Offer to fix playback when PotHelper no longer works or the default client keeps failing
• Update to Patcher 2.0
• YouTube - Add to queue: Add Premium-style queue setting
• YouTube - Captions: Add "Show captions in picture-in-picture" setting
• YouTube - Captions: Add additional automatic translation languages
• YouTube - Channel search: Added loading animation during searching
• YouTube - Disable video codecs: Add "Force VP9 codec" setting
• YouTube - Downloads: Add "Download in-app" setting
• YouTube - Force animations: Expand the content below the player with its animation when it loads
• YouTube - Hide layout components: Add "Hide 'No comments yet' message" setting
• YouTube - Hide layout components: Add "Hide live chat scroll to bottom button" setting
• YouTube - Hide status bar: Add "Fix status bar covering the top bars" setting
• YouTube - Player icon style: Add Series tracker button icons
• YouTube - Restore original titles: Restore titles of watch history and fullscreen suggested videos
• YouTube - Return YouTube Dislike: Add "Show feed thumbnail like count" setting
• YouTube - Series tracking: Add "Show Series in navigation bar" setting
• YouTube: Add "Force animations" patch, superseding the Miniplayer watch transition fix
• YouTube: Add Ask flyout menu patch
• YouTube: Add Custom font patch
• YouTube: Add Feed video actions patch
• YouTube: Add Feed view count patch
• YouTube: Add Series tracking patch
• YouTube: Add Video delay patch
• YouTube: Add playback speed for Shorts and skip live Shorts
• YouTube: Added new feed card layout
• YouTube: Added new feed cards layout without action buttons

🚀 Updated App Support
• YouTube: Add experimental support for 21.41.525
• YouTube: Add experimental support for 21.42.240
